title: CBRN: Rope Rescue technicians
description: U.S. Marines with Chemical Biological Radiological and Nuclear Platoon, Headquarters Battalion, 3rd Marine Division, participate in a rope rescue technicians course at Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, Okinawa, Japan, July 29, 2020. The CBRN Platoon conducted rescue training at a cave as part of an ongoing ropes course, in order to maintain proficiency in specialized rescue techniques. The Marines were wearing masks while conducting the training to reduce any risks associated with the spread of COVID-19. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Josue Marquez)
keywords: CBRN, MCAS Futenma, 3rd Mar. Div., rope rescue technicians course, Marines, Okinawa, Marine Corps, Japan, USMC, Marine Corps Air Station Futenma, 3rd Marine Division
